text_block_list.text: (Nghh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy. I heard a 
faint, adorable sound coming from 
somewhere—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool! That wasn't my stomach growling!! 
Are your ears just for decoration?! Good 
grief!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you slice it, that was 
clearly a beast's roar just now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering where it came from, I looked 
around. And then...

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: *whimper*... *whine*...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A puppy...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're injured. These peck marks... Were 
you attacked by crows living nearby?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No collar... Hmm.
choice_data_list: We need to treat this first...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait. While acting without hesitation for 
a good cause is a virtue, if the treatment 
isn't appropriate, it devolves into 
foolishness.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First, we should consult an expert. If I 
recall, if you spot a stray in this area—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for your time. My name is 
Air Groove, a student at Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I found an injured puppy without a collar 
down by the riverbed near the academy, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having received a call from Air Groove, 
the rescue organization rushed over 
immediately and tended to the puppy's 
injuries.

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
—Right, all done! The injury itself was 
minor, so they'll be back on their feet in 
no time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see...! That is wonderful to hear. Thank 
you very much for your swift response.

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
Likewise! Thank you for handling it so 
well. ...Come on, say 'thank you' too.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof! Whimper~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Hey, don't thrash around so much! 
You're getting energetic way too fast, 
your wound's gonna reopen!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Waf! Waf!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... haha. You really are hopeless, 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Hey, what's your problem? Got 
something to say to me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“Cut the lies, your attitude makes it 
painfully obvious! Out with it, you—”

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... Sorry to interrupt when you're 
busy. Do you have a moment...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...! N-No, I'm not busy. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Um. Regarding this child's 
future, though—

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, unfortunately, all of our cages 
are currently completely full...”

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
Could you look after this little one until 
we can find someone to take them in?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Advocacy Group Woman
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm asking for the impossible, but 
please! She's already grown so fond of 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"B-But... as a rule, pets are strictly 
forbidden on academy grounds."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I've never owned a dog before. 
I wonder if I can truly provide it with 
the full care it deserves...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Air Groove hesitated, but remembering her 
smile from earlier, her true feelings 
surely lay elsewhere. So—"
choice_data_list:
Guess I could look after it in my room 
then~

Guess I could look after it in my room 
then~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Air Groove hesitated, but remembering her 
smile from earlier, her true feelings 
surely lay elsewhere. So—"
choice_data_list:
Guess I could look after it in my room 
then~

Guess I could look after it in my room 
then~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What was that!? You'd better be saying 
that having anticipated every possible 
contingency!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keeping a pet means you cannot simply 
pamper and spoil it, you know!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And with a dog, the hardship is beyond 
imagination! Daily walks, proper 
discipline, grooming—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You bastard, keeping that all to 
yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.
choice_data_list: Dogs are so cute, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ………………Aaargh, shut up!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As if I could leave this to an 
irresponsible slacker like you! With 
special permission granted, this child is 
under my care!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The joyful yips of a puppy echoed at 
Air Groove's feet."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're fine... you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You bastard... this is a matter of this 
child's life. Keep spouting nonsense, 
and—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Based on what?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm her Trainer, I know Air Groove 
is someone who can be completely trusted 
with this... is what I told them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your optimism is honestly infuriating. 
However—I will answer your trust.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, come here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The joyful yips of a puppy echoed at 
Air Groove's feet."
